investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: A production NSG (nsg-aks-prod-northeast in rg-nordic-prod-001) was modified by a ServicePrincipal with Contributor scope at 2026-10-18T14:16:17Z (17:16:17 Europe/Tallinn). The request_body shows a deny rule targeting multiple Russia-related prefixes and an allow rule permitting Internet access to 40.113.112.55 on ports 80/443, consistent with exposing an AKS load balancer while also applying geo-based blocks. Activity originated in Norway East and occurred during normal administrative hours for Estonia, and no recent events or similar alerts were found; taken together the change appears to be plausible automated deployment activity and is assessed as Low Priority.
investigation_notes.Rule Changes Summary: Added/modified 'SanctionBlocks' (Deny) targeting multiple Russia-related source prefixes and 'k8s-azure-lb-allow' (Allow) permitting Internet -> 40.113.112.55 on TCP ports 80/443.
investigation_notes.Correlation Findings: No recent deployment events found. No recent similar alerts found.
